recipe: LongCat Avatar presenter + SeedVR2 on one card
note: Every entry is a transcription made by the studio. The basis field is the studio's original wording; read it with the label in the recipe: an entry without a published raw file is REPORTED, whatever its basis says.

receipts.claim: Talking-presenter stage (LongCat-Video-Avatar-1.5, 8-step distilled, bf16, 480p), 15 s of speech
receipts.value: 15.0 s clip, 375 frames at 832x480, 25 fps; 707.3 s wall = 593 s active + 111 s paused (53 pauses of 2 to 4 s); GPU peak 89 C; 70,596 MiB whole-card; 300.6 W
receipts.caveat: Five 80-frame continuation segments; pauses are an external pacer at 88 C / resume 84 C, so about 18% of the wall time is cooling. One run, one synthetic still, one 15-second voice-over, ambient as of the day.

receipts.value: 404.7 s wall for 375 frames in and 375 out (10 chunks); GPU peak 83 C; 79,478 MiB whole-card; 0 s paused
receipts.caveat: Chunks sized to the 41-frame budget; the 33 GB fp32 checkpoint load is about 40 s of the wall time (inference from telemetry).

receipts.claim: Card time per second of finished video
receipts.value: about 36 GPU-seconds (presenter) + 27 GPU-seconds (upscaler), roughly an hour of card time per minute of presenter video
receipts.caveat: 593 s / 16.52 s generated video; 399 s / 15 s. Paced by cooling at the day's ambient; not a sustained-rate claim. A 60-second piece would be about an hour of one card.

receipts.value: GPU stages 1,111.8 s (18.5 min); final file 1920x1080, 25 fps, -17.0 LUFS; assembly 1.6 s
receipts.caveat: The presenter layer has 720p-class detail, upscaled 1.52x to 1080p by resize; the 1080p-class upscaler path exists and was not measured.

receipts.value: identity stable across all four segment joins (12 join frames); no visible seam; luma step at nine upscaler joins at most 0.89 against 3.34 between ordinary frames; lip motion plausible on four spot checks
receipts.caveat: One reviewer, working from stills. Nobody has watched it with sound yet; lip-sync accuracy was not scored. Artifacts seen: a pink cast on the lips in wide-open frames, slightly over-sharpened skin and hair, hands entering at the bottom edge in the last two seconds.

receipts.claim: Earlier smoke test of the presenter model: retracted pace figure
receipts.value: a stated 9.8 s per video-second (68 s active + 157 s paused) was wrong; the worker kept running during the "paused" samples (98.7% utilisation, 297 W)
receipts.caveat: The pause signal reached the launcher but not the worker, because the launcher starts the worker in its own session. Corrected: about 33 s per video-second at 640x608, matching P-03. The fix is to signal the whole process tree.

receipts.value: 91.9 s wall cold (about 40 s checkpoint load), one denoise step of 3.76 s, 74.9 GB whole-card, 80 C, 301 W
receipts.caveat: Single run; a visual spot check, nothing more (a wave crest slightly over-sharpened, which the authors warn about for generated inputs).

receipts.claim: Workarounds needed on this stack (SM120, CUDA 12.9 wheels, driver 570)
receipts.value: 3 shims (attention to PyTorch SDPA, RMSNorm replacement, video I/O via PyAV) plus a one-line patched copy of the upscaler script; the presenter demo needs an official base-component directory next to the avatar weights
receipts.caveat: The SDPA and norm shims are not the original FlashAttention or apex kernels, so numerics differ slightly from the reference stack. Quality was spot-checked, not measured.

receipts.value: the presenter demo fixes its seed at 42; the command-line seed does not reach it
receipts.caveat: Identical inputs give the same result; a retake with another seed needs a wrapper.

receipts.value: LongCat-Video-Avatar-1.5 @ 92016c71d5d318d0f5d84e4db30015a571484ab6, MIT; LongCat-Video base @ 03b55529b1d1d4045f5fbe14d65c8c6e8116b278, MIT; SeedVR2-7B @ eb0c4281d41ba3767d4f14370f0e37e9e9180c16, Apache-2.0
receipts.caveat: Licences as stated on the model cards at download; the pipeline also uses a speech-separation model, a transcription model and a voice-synthesis model whose licences are not covered by this recipe.

receipts.value: 3 per run (voice clean-up, presenter, upscaler); the other job on the card yielded each time in about a second
receipts.caveat: The card is exclusively leased; each stage takes it, waits for no other compute owner, runs, and releases.

receipts.value: pieces longer than about 17 s (identity drift over many segments), vertical 9:16 output, higher presenter resolution, INT8 variant, 1080p-class upscaling, listening test
receipts.caveat: These are the next items before this is routine.
